description: arXiv:2611.22661v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Executing an idea often changes how promising it looks, so the next step in autonomous research should rest on results, not on proposals. After each round of experiments, the system must decide whether to refine the best solution or start a new direction, which solution to build from, and what goal to set. We call this the between-round decision....
author: Caoxin Wang, Shengkai Gan, Xiang Hu, Lili Pan
